description: Details of one keyboard work in the Klavierstuck catalogue, by its slug: composer, catalogue references (Op., BWV, K., S.…), key, composition and publication dates, duration, instrument, performing forces, sub-genres, era, difficulty ratings with their scale, child works in order (e.g. the pieces of a set) and external links (IMSLP, Wikipedia, recordings). Returns the klavierstuck.org URL and the data sources to cite.

slug.description: The work's slug, as in https://klavierstuck.org/work/<slug>, e.g. "3-nocturnes-op-9-chopin".
